question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Glorify
solution:
The correct answer is: **Praise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Glorify **means to praise or honour something or someone. (किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति की प्रशंसा या सम्मान करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The fans glorified the football team after their victory in the championship.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Praise **is a noun that refers to the expression of approval, admiration, or compliments given to someone for their achievements, qualities, or actions. (किसी को उसकी उपलब्धियों, गुणों या कार्यों के लिए दी गई स्वीकृति, प्रशंसा या प्रशंसा की अभिव्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example**: *He received praise from his colleagues for his innovative ideas that improved the company's productivity.*
 
 
 
• Other synonyms of Glorify include exalt, extol, laud, and acclaim.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simplify **means to make something easier to understand or do. (किसी चीज़ को समझना या करना आसान बनाना)
 
• **Stupefy **means to stun or shock someone, leaving them unable to think or act. (किसी को स्तब्ध या चौंका देना, जिससे वह सोचने या कार्य करने में असमर्थ हो जाए)
 
• **Strengthen **means to make something stronger or more powerful. (किसी चीज़ को मजबूत या अधिक शक्तिशाली बनाना)
